topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 71 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 3 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 9 common project-authored base contract(s) (kept, kept_arbitrum, instance). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
